ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) central region spanning the fluke hinge and extending into the proximal lobe areas. High-intensity (white) pigmentation dominates the distal 60% of both lobes. A distinct vertical low-intensity band is present mid-way through the right lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the continuous boundary; the left lobe trailing edge shows low-amplitude, high-frequency peaks, while the right lobe trailing edge exhibits deeper, irregular jagged notches especially towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a predominantly convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single high-contrast dark circular cluster on the distal right lobe white field; secondary lower-contrast clusters visible on the medial right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel, horizontal, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white pigmentation field on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear raking marks on the right lobe; prominent circular dark mark or lesion on the distal right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The boundary between black and white pigment regions is highly irregular and asymmetric, characterized by a jagged 'bleeding' interface on the right lobe compared to a smoother transition on the left.
